title: Siding Calculator
cardBlurb: Squares and cartons of siding for house walls
metaDescription: Estimate squares (100 sq ft) of vinyl or fiber-cement siding for house walls and gable ends in feet, with the Vinyl Siding Institute's 10% waste allowance.
secondaryKeywords: how many squares of siding do i need
how to measure a house for siding
intent: Estimate squares or cartons of vinyl or fiber-cement siding for house walls, including gable ends, openings, and waste.
registerRow: Not on the Oct 2026 Keyword Register: category-fill addition (Siding and Exterior) chosen by the redesign brief; no overlap with Shingle (roof) or Paint (coating).
intro: Enter your house's length, width, wall height, and gable ends (or a wall area) to get squares of siding to order, with the Vinyl Siding Institute's 10% waste allowance.
chartTitle: Where the siding area comes from (sq ft)
diagramCaption: Gable-end elevation with the wall height and gable height. It redraws as you type.
uniqueAddition: Gable-end triangles added to the four walls with the Vinyl Siding Institute's own estimating method (squares of 100 sq ft plus 10% waste, openings not deducted by default), and a table of squares for common house sizes.

inputs.name: houseWidth
inputs.label: House width
inputs.help: Short side (the gable end), 4 to 200 ft.

inputs.name: wallHeight
inputs.label: Wall height
inputs.help: Foundation to the eaves, 4 to 40 ft.

inputs.name: gables
inputs.label: Gable ends to side
inputs.help: Whole number, 0 to 4. A simple gable roof has 2; a hip roof has 0.

inputs.name: gableRise
inputs.label: Gable height
inputs.help: Eaves line to the peak, 0.5 to 40 ft. A 6/12 roof on a 30 ft wide house is 7.5 ft.

inputs.name: openings
inputs.label: Doors and windows to deduct
inputs.help: 0 to skip. The VSI method doesn't deduct openings; it lets them cover waste. Deduct only large openings like garage doors.

inputs.name: cartonCoverage
inputs.label: Coverage per carton (optional)
inputs.help: From the carton label, often listed in squares (2 squares = 200 sq ft). Leave blank to skip cartons.

inputs.name: waste
inputs.label: Waste allowance
inputs.help: 0 to 30%. The Vinyl Siding Institute says to add 10% to all material estimates. Raise it for many corners or dormers.

sources.title: Vinyl Siding Installation Manual, Estimating Required Materials (Vinyl Siding Institute, 2022 edition, hosted by the Polymeric Exteriors Coalition): squares of 100 sq ft, gable area, add 10% for waste
Vinyl Siding Installation Manual, updated December 2007 (Vinyl Siding Institute): same estimating method and 10% waste factor
